description: Dense reference adiabatic/annealing evolution for a Hamiltonian path H(s) = (1 - s) H0 + s H1. Discretizes the schedule and returns a dense unitary.
applicable_hamiltonians: Small dense-matrix systems with an initial Hamiltonian and final/problem Hamiltonian
Adiabatic or annealing primitives where the goal is time evolution, not full optimization workflow orchestration
limitations: Current implementation is a dense classical reference primitive, not a full quantum annealing workflow
Requires dense Hermitian matrix terms with matching dimensions
Supports linear and simple power schedules only
Does not estimate spectral gaps or choose schedules automatically
Accuracy depends on schedule smoothness, step count, Hamiltonian path, spectral gap, and total evolution time

initial_terms.description: Initial Hamiltonian terms H0 at schedule value s = 0.

schedule.description: Schedule specification. Defaults to linear; also supports {"type": "power", "power": p}.

execution.returns: EvolutionResult containing a dense unitary approximating time-ordered evolution along a scheduled Hamiltonian path. The evolve entrypoint returns the dense unitary directly.

complexity.gate_count: Reference dense implementation; eventual circuit cost depends on schedule and Hamiltonian path decomposition
complexity.circuit_depth: Reference dense implementation; no circuit depth is emitted in v0.1
complexity.error_scaling: Schedule-discretization error depends on step count, Hamiltonian-path commutators, gap behavior, and total evolution time

references.title: Quantum Computation by Adiabatic Evolution
references.authors: E. Farhi, J. Goldstone, S. Gutmann, and M. Sipser

references.title: Adiabatic quantum computation
references.authors: T. Albash and D. A. Lidar
